user.title: Rika Firenet Connection
user.description: Configure the connection with your Rika Firenet account to control your stove.

data_description.connection_type: Choose between Rika Firenet Cloud (rika-firenet.com) or local direct HTTP with Open Firenet.
data_description.host: Bridge hostname or local IP address for Open Firenet (e.g., open-firenet.local or 192.168.1.50).
data_description.username: The email address used to log in at www.rika-firenet.com (Cloud only)
data_description.password: The password for your Rika Firenet account (Cloud only)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Open Firenet bridge.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration of Rika Firenet is allowed.

init.title: Rika Firenet Options
init.description: Adjust operational settings and choose which entity types to expose.

data.schedule_entity: Schedule to copy to the stove (HA Helper)

data_description.defaultTemperature: Fallback setpoint temperature used by default if not specified (default: 21 °C).
data_description.defaultScanInterval: Polling frequency from the Rika Firenet cloud (default: 15 seconds).
data_description.pendingTimeout: Maximum timeout before alert and abort if stove does not confirm commands (default: 300 s / 5 min).
data_description.climate: Exposes the main climate entity to control mode, target temperature, and state.
data_description.sensor: Exposes sensors: room temperature, pellet consumption, power, fan velocity, etc.
data_description.binary_sensor: Exposes binary sensors: door open, pellet lid, Wi-Fi signal, grid contact, etc.
data_description.switch: Exposes on/off controls: stove on/off, heating times, convection fans.
data_description.number: Exposes numeric controls: heating power, convection fan areas, set back temperature.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A Home Assistant schedule helper drawn as a weekly grid. The "Copy schedule to the stove" button sends it to the stove.
data_description.button: Exposes buttons to copy, send, or discard heating schedule.
data_description.time: Exposes individual time entities for each day slot.
